# Technically Speaking

> Live cohort-based communication training for teams. TECH gives teams a practical model for sharpening ideas, making their value clear and getting clients, executives and colleagues to act on them.

Technically Speaking is a live, cohort-based program for teams whose work depends on other people making decisions. Participants practice real proposals, recommendations, executive updates and client conversations. They receive direct feedback, handle pushback live and use the same TECH language after the cohort so managers can continue coaching the work.

## The TECH Model
A shared way to prepare for important workplace conversations:
- **T — Target Audience:** Know who you’re talking to, what matters to the business, and what matters to them.
- **E — End Goal:** Ask clearly for what you want, and know how you’ll handle pushback.
- **C — Clarity:** Use stories and metaphors to make complex work easy to grasp and its impact on your audience obvious.
- **H — How You Say It:** Use pace, volume, tone, and pauses to make the important parts land.

## The program
- Format: six weeks, once a week, 90-minute live sessions.
- Cohort size: six participants.
- Price: $18,000 USD per cohort ($3,000 per person).
- Includes: discovery and customization, six live sessions with personalized feedback, baseline and endline TECH assessments, the TECH AI Coach for practice, a final pitch to the program sponsor, and sponsor check-ins at three and six months.
- Who it is for: engineering, partnerships, research, product and support teams whose work depends on other people approving, funding or acting on it.

## Proof
- Jungle Scout — Sam Johnson, CTO: “Proposals now hit the points I care about, so we can get to decisions a lot more quickly.” An engineering manager also handled a live incident with executives while Sam was away.
- TextNow — Andrew Cotton, Head of Security, Compliance & IT: “I talk to my CFO and COO completely differently now. I learned to get to the real problem underneath what people say.”
- MLSE — Katee Carrasco, Director, Global Partnerships: a participant used the lessons on a client call the same afternoon as the first session.
- Other clients include CTO Craft, SaaS North and TechTO.

## Founder
Michaud Garneau created the TECH Model and runs every Technically Speaking session. He has more than ten years of experience teaching technical people to communicate, and is a TEDx speaker and LinkedIn Learning instructor.
